entries.title: Psalms 108:1
segments: ¶<A Song. A Psalm. Of David.> O God, my heart is fixed; I will make songs and melody, even with my glory.

entries.title: Psalms 108:2
segments: Give out your sounds, O corded instruments: the dawn will be awaking with my song.

entries.title: Psalms 108:3
segments: I will give you praise, O Lord, among the peoples; I will make melody to you among the nations.

entries.title: Psalms 108:4
segments: For your mercy is higher than the heavens: and your unchanging faith than the clouds.

entries.title: Psalms 108:5
segments: Be lifted up, O God, higher than the heavens; let your glory be over all the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 108:6
segments: ¶Let your right hand be stretched out for salvation, and give me an answer, so that your loved ones may be safe from danger.

entries.title: Psalms 108:7
segments: This is the word of the holy God: I will be glad; I will make Shechem a heritage, measuring out the valley of Succoth.

entries.title: Psalms 108:8
segments: Gilead is mine; Manasseh is mine; Ephraim is the strength of my head; Judah is my law-giver;

entries.title: Psalms 108:9
segments: Moab is my washpot; on Edom is the resting-place of my shoe; over Philistia will I send out a glad cry.

entries.title: Psalms 108:10
segments: Who will take me into the strong town? who will be my guide into Edom?

entries.title: Psalms 108:11
segments: Have you not sent us away from you, O God? and you go not out with our armies.

entries.title: Psalms 108:12
segments: Give us help in our trouble; for there is no help in man.

entries.title: Psalms 108:13
segments: With God we will do great things; for by him will our haters be crushed underfoot.
